doc: [C] Kimi Code approves reads by default; its lock (a manual-mode `config.toml` in a hub-owned `KIMI_CODE_HOME`, with an ask rule for the subscribed kinds' tools) makes its `Read` ask. The `kimi` personality obeys its config as Kimi Code does: it asks with no `kind`, the seam takes `read` from the folded tool call, and a rule on `read` refuses the step. A default-approved step of a kind no hook subscribes to (`Grep`) still runs without asking.

text: (drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-profiles (("mock-kimi" :provider kimi :command ("$MOCK" "acp" "--as" "kimi" "--log" "$ROOT/acp.log" "--yolo")))) (drgnx-agents-matrix (:cells ((:action code.edit :column (:role worker) :verdict allow) (:action code.read :column (:role worker) :verdict allow)))))

sql: select json_extract(e.data, '$.records[0].source') from event e join tx t on t.id = e.tx where t.actor = 'hub:hooks' order by e.id
